The idea is that moving marijuana from Schedule 1, which says that it has no medical use, to Schedule 3, is all a part of this evil capitalist conspiracy so more transsexual mass murderers can kill more children. Really!

Of  Course The New York Post Blames Minneapolis Shooting On Weed

 

Now, admittedly,  big business in America has done some horrible things like bring us cheap automobiles, invented computers and smartphones, and airplanes, and televisions and Bugs Bunny, and other bad stuff. But medical marijuana wasn’t one of them.

 

Personally, I blame a gay hippie Vietnam veteran weed dealer in San Francisco named Dennis Peron. Of course, he had a number of accomplices, but there were no big businesses of any kind around.

 

But, there was lots of Big Government on the other side.

See Threats Against Doctors Who Recommend Medical Marijuana More Subtle Than 2 Years Ago,

But Arizona Narcs Will "Refer" Doctors To Feds -- 3 Articles

 

The fact is that the legal marijuana industry has been a financial disaster for most investors, and that is not unusual. Most of the early automakers went out of business.

 

But how big is Big Marijuana?

Revenue in the Cannabis market in the United States is forecasted to reach US$46.99bn in 2025

 

That sounds big, but the gross domestic product of the US economy is $30.5 trillion

 

In 2025, the revenue in the Tobacco Products market in the United States amounts to US$108.5bn.

 

The US Alcoholic Drinks Market size is valued at around USD 415 billion in 2024 .

 

Meanwhile, “Roughly 75 percent of the $100 billion cannabis market in the U.S. remains illegal, and roughly two-thirds of that illicit weed is grown domestically, as noted by data from Whitney Economics, which analyzes the cannabis industry. In regulated states like California, illegal grow operations outnumber licensed grows by 10 to one, according to a 2022 LA Times article.”

 

And remember, according to the FBI: Nearly One Quarter of All Drug-Related Arrests Are for Marijuana Possession

 

So are the Prohibitionists who want to keep marijuana in the black market really tools of Big Prohibition? Or perhaps they are tools of organized crime, or maybe they just hate babies and puppy dogs.

 

Questioning the motives of the opposition is a lot easier than honestly addressing the facts  and the real history.
